name: pumi-usage
description: How much of your AI plans you have left, in a section of the side bar: Claude, Codex, Copilot and OpenRouter, read with the sign-ins already on this Mac.

every.label: Read them again every
every.desc: The services rate limit these endpoints and the numbers move slowly, so a read every few minutes is plenty.

alert.label: Say when a limit is nearly out
alert.desc: A notification once each window crosses the critical share, and not again until that window resets.

claude.label: Claude
claude.desc: Claude Code's sign-in: its login keychain item, or `~/.claude/.credentials.json`. A Claude Code pointed at another endpoint (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, apiKeyHelper) is left alone: it is not using the plan.

codex.label: Codex
codex.desc: The Codex CLI's ChatGPT sign-in (`~/.codex/auth.json`), or OpenCode's OpenAI one. An API key has no plan usage to read.

copilot.label: Copilot
copilot.desc: The GitHub token `gh auth token` answers with, or a Copilot editor plugin's own sign-in. Premium requests and chat, by the month.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.desc: Prepaid credits and the API key's own spending cap, read with the key below or `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.

resets.label: Resets
resets.desc: `Time left` counts down (`2h 53m`); `When it resets` names the local time it comes back.

tint.label: Colour by how little is left
tint.desc: Numbers and meters turn the warning colour, then the error colour, as a window fills.

warn_at.label: Warning at
warn_at.desc: A window this used is drawn in the theme's warning colour.

crit_at.label: Critical at
crit_at.desc: A window this used is drawn in the theme's error colour, and `Say when a limit is nearly out` speaks.

copilot_token.label: GitHub token for Copilot
copilot_token.desc: Only needed when `gh` is not signed in on this Mac: the output of `gh auth token` works. Kept in the login keychain.

openrouter_key.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_key.desc: An `sk-or-v1-…` key from openrouter.ai/settings/keys, when `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is not in the app's environment. Kept in the login keychain.
